lessons.title: Practice Stack with a List
lessons.description: Implement Stack with push, pop, and peek using a Python list (end is top). The test checks that Stack().peek() equals 2; Stack().pop() equals 2; len(s) equals 1.
learning_objectives: Depot pickers recount crates before dawn, and model LIFO with list append pop.

tests.name: test_stack
tests.unittest_code:
def test_stack(self):
    s = Stack()
    s.push(1); s.push(2)
    self.assertEqual(s.peek(), 2)
    self.assertEqual(s.pop(), 2)
    self.assertEqual(len(s), 1)

source.name: Python official documentation (docs.python.org) — 5.1.1. Using Lists as Stacks — append()/pop() (Tutorial)

lessons.title: Practice Queue with collections deque
lessons.description: Implement Queue with enqueue/dequeue using collections.deque. The test checks that Queue().dequeue() equals 'a'; len(q) equals 1.
learning_objectives: Ridge pickers recount crates before dawn, and model FIFO with deque.

tests.name: test_queue
tests.unittest_code:
def test_queue(self):
    q = Queue()
    q.enqueue('a'); q.enqueue('b')
    self.assertEqual(q.dequeue(), 'a')
    self.assertEqual(len(q), 1)
